svg.text: an x86 driver in front of Arm executors, one query:
SELECT x FROM t WHERE cos(x) = cos(0.1)
the driver, x86 (here the Ryzen AI 9 HX PRO 370)
plans the query and folds the literal
the row x = 0.1 is kept only if the two answers agree
fdlibm (StrictMath), the same on every host: 0.9950041652780257
